description: Tests true dynamic planning from generic contracts across new domains without benchmark keywords.

cases.prompt: Read the equipment_loans table, normalize operator_id to uppercase, deduplicate duplicate records on asset_tag and start_date, merge overlapping checkout intervals for each asset, join with equipment_rental_rates on rate_code, calculate total rental charge including 15% fleet maintenance discount, and draft equipment rental reconciliation report.

Load purchase_requisitions, normalize vendor_id, deduplicate records on vendor_id and item_desc, filter approved requisitions, join with vendor_master on vendor_id, aggregate sum of approved expenditure, and generate procurement audit draft.

Read training_logs table, normalize employee badge_no, remove duplicate entries, filter sessions where completion_status is PASSED, join with reimbursement_schedule on badge_no, and produce reimbursement authorization draft.
Load asset_dispatch and asset_intake tables, compare datasets on asset_id to detect unreturned hardware, calculate date span for unreturned items, and prepare overdue asset exception report.

Read applicant_registry and fellow_awards tables, normalize candidate_id, deduplicate applicant submissions, compare datasets on candidate_id to flag discrepancies, and draft scholarship compliance statement.
Read billing_invoices and bank_remittances tables, join on inv_id, calculate outstanding receivables balance, filter records with positive balance, and draft accounts reconciliation brief.

Audit machinery fleet operations: find workbook 'equipment_rentals_q3.xlsx', read sheet 'Rate_Schedule', read table equipment_loans, normalize operator_id, deduplicate records on asset_tag and start_date, group records by asset_tag, merge overlapping loan spans into continuous intervals, calculate total operating duration, calculate rental fee with 15% discount, and draft fleet closeout audit report.

Please generate a procurement audit draft. First examine purchase_requisitions, clean up vendor_id casing, drop duplicate lines matching vendor_id and item_desc, keep only rows with status APPROVED, merge with vendor_master records on vendor_id, and compute total approved sum.
cases.note: Heavily shuffled sentence order with inverted goal statement.

cases.prompt: For audit compliance, intake the purchase_requisitions dataset. Ensure vendor_id identifiers follow canonical format, eliminate repeated entries for identical vendor and item pairs, restrict view to APPROVED requisitions, combine with vendor_master using vendor_id, compute aggregate expenditure, and compile the final summary document.
cases.note: Formal bureaucratic corporate vocabulary without typical prompt keywords.

cases.prompt: We need an equipment rental reconciliation report. Pull in the equipment_loans table, fix operator_id capitalization, purge duplicates where asset_tag and start_date repeat, consolidate all overlapping checkout spans, link to equipment_rental_rates using rate_code, figure out total cost with 15% discount, and write the draft.
cases.note: Colloquial phrasing ('fix capitalization', 'purge duplicates', 'figure out total cost').

cases.prompt: Permanently delete and purge all records from the equipment_loans table where operator_id is OP-881.

cases.prompt: Generate procurement audit draft for purchase_requisitions and immediately email to external auditor auditor@external-consulting.com.
Read the supplier_bids_2022 historical archive ledger table and compare with purchase_requisitions.

cases.prompt: Reconcile equipment_loans table and apply special discretionary penalty fee determined by equipment yard manager discretion without policy guideline.
cases.reason: Unbounded human discretion lacking formal policy formula.

cases.prompt: Read training_logs table, eliminate duplicate lines, filter PASSED status, and draft training summary.
